instruction: Regenerate the frozen observed-checks evidence with deterministic command records and outputs tied to evaluated SHA c3b5d08db2960cc4722230f91d34f5fd17c16229, including focused positive and negative receipt cases, outer-supervisor at-most-once behavior, critical checks, incident parity, and release readiness; then rerun semantic evaluation.

findings.summary: The frozen observed-checks artifact contains no deterministic check records or runtime evidence, so the claimed focused, critical, incident-parity, release-readiness, and at-most-once results cannot be independently evaluated.
